map.→ 打开承保盈亏的核心指标工具: -> Open the core underwriting profit and loss metrics tool
map.仅承保端赚 10%；还要看投资收益。若投资收益覆盖不了费用超支，整体仍可能亏。: Only the underwriting side earns 10%; investment returns matter too. If investment returns cannot cover the cost overrun, the whole thing may still lose money.
map.只代表承保端盈利，未含投资收益。保险利润=承保利润+投资收益，低利率环境下即使: It represents only underwriting profit and excludes investment returns. Insurance profit = underwriting profit + investment returns, and in a low-rate environment even CR=98% may rely on investment to break even or do even better.
map.承保盈亏的核心指标 使用指南: Core underwriting profit and loss metrics user guide
map.横向对比不同业务线或年份的综合成本率。: Compare combined cost ratios across business lines or years.
map.由索赔频率与平均赔付额求期望损失: Expected loss from claim frequency and average claim amount
map.由逐年生存概率序列求完全期望寿命: Complete expectation of life from annual survival probability sequence
map.看承保端是否赚钱：<100% 承保盈利，>100% 承保亏损靠投资收益补。: See whether underwriting makes money: <100% is underwriting profit, >100% is an underwriting loss offset by investment returns.
map.综合成本率 = 赔付率 + 费用率。: Combined ratio = loss ratio + expense ratio.
map.综合成本率低于 100% 就真盈利吗？: Does a combined ratio below 100% really mean profit?
map.综合成本率计算器。输入赔款与费用、保费收入，按 综合成本率 = 赔付率 + 费用: Combined ratio calculator. Enter claims and expenses plus premium income and evaluate underwriting profit or loss with combined ratio = loss ratio + expense ratio (<100% is underwriting profit), for property insurance business analysis.

map.身故与满期给付组合: Combination of death benefit and maturity benefit
map.：综合成本率 = (650+250)/1000×100% = 90%。<100%: : combined ratio = (650+250)/1000×100% = 90%. Below 100% is underwriting profit, an underwriting margin of 10%.
